dedupe_keys.name: bikenetkit open source toolkit for bicycle network planning

description: BikeNetKit is a digital toolkit, begun in 2026, that packages bicycle network planning algorithms from the research community, kick-started by the NERDS group at the IT University of Copenhagen, as a Python software suite. It is aimed at urban planners as decision support for network planning tasks, and at citizens who want to make a case for cycling in their city: closing gaps in a bike network, connecting its components or building one from scratch. The organisation's page lists its tools and status: superblockify (stable, 1.0.2), GrowBikeNet (beta, 0.14.5), FixBikeNet (beta, 0.8.2), LinkBikeNet (alpha, 0.7.2), SortBikeNet (alpha, 0.5.0) and BikeNetLib (alpha, 0.5.0). An interactive visualisation platform is planned at bikenetkit.org by November 2026. Development is supported by Innovation Fund Denmark, the EU Horizon project JUST STREETS and the IT University. Coverage: any city. Format and access: Python packages on GitHub. Licence and cost: free, under a copyleft licence per the project page (each package's licence file was not read). Caveats: most tools are alpha or beta and under active development. It supports network flow, optimisation and capacity planning for cycling networks. It complements BikeNodePlanner and BikeDNA in the catalogue.
